046/**
047 * Creates formatters from pattern keywords and are registered to a
048 * {@link PatternRegistry}.
049 */
050public sealed interface PatternFormatterFactory {
051
052        /**
053         * Whether this factory's formatter renders (or, like <code>%nopex</code>,
054         * deliberately suppresses) a throwable, and thus counts as the pattern having
055         * addressed exception rendering itself. {@link PatternCompiler} appends a default
056         * exception formatter to any pattern where every keyword answers {@code false} here,
057         * so a logged throwable is never silently dropped just because the pattern forgot to
058         * ask for it - see the built-in throwable keywords and Spring Boot's
059         * <code>%wEx</code>/<code>%wex</code> for the keywords that override this.
060         * @return {@code false} by default.
061         */
062        default boolean isExceptionFormatter() {
063                return false;
064        }
065
066        /**
067         * A composite formatter factory expects possible children. For example
068         * {@code %keyword(child) }.
069         */
070        public non-sealed interface CompositeFactory extends PatternFormatterFactory {
071
072                /**
073                 * Creates a formatter from a keyword.
074                 * @param config config to help create formatter.
075                 * @param node current keyword info.
076                 * @param child the embedded child in the keyword or null if non is provided.
077                 * @return formatter.
078                 */
079                public LogFormatter create(PatternConfig config, PatternKeyword node, @Nullable LogFormatter child);
080
081        }
082
083        /**
084         * A keyword formatter factory expects keywords and option list. It is usually in the
085         * format of {@code %keyword}.
086         */
087        public non-sealed interface KeywordFactory extends PatternFormatterFactory {
088
089                /**
090                 * Creates a formatter from a keyword.
091                 * @param config config to help create formatter.
092                 * @param node current keyword info.
093                 * @return formatter.
094                 */
095                public LogFormatter create(PatternConfig config, PatternKeyword node);
096
097                /**
098                 * Creates a keyword factory from a formatter that only cares about padding info.
099                 * @param formatter existing formatter.
100                 * @return factory.
101                 */
102                static PatternFormatterFactory.KeywordFactory of(LogFormatter formatter) {
103                        return (c, n) -> PadFormatter.of(formatter, n.padding());
104                }
105
106                /**
107                 * Creates a keyword factory from a formatter that only cares about padding info,
108                 * additionally marking it as {@link #isExceptionFormatter()}. Lambdas cannot
109                 * override default methods, hence this overload instead of a plain lambda for
110                 * keywords like <code>%nopex</code> that need to.
111                 * @param formatter existing formatter.
112                 * @param isExceptionFormatter value to return from
113                 * {@link #isExceptionFormatter()}.
114                 * @return factory.
115                 */
116                static PatternFormatterFactory.KeywordFactory of(LogFormatter formatter, boolean isExceptionFormatter) {
117                        return new KeywordFactory() {
118                                @Override
119                                public LogFormatter create(PatternConfig config, PatternKeyword node) {
120                                        return PadFormatter.of(formatter, node.padding());
121                                }
122
123                                @Override
124                                public boolean isExceptionFormatter() {
125                                        return isExceptionFormatter;
126                                }
127                        };
128                }
129
130        }
131
132        /**
133         * Parses the depth (<code>full</code>/<code>short</code>/a number) and exclude regex
134         * options shared by throwable keywords such as <code>%ex</code>/<code>%xEx</code> and
135         * Spring Boot's <code>%wEx</code>.
136         * @param node keyword node holding the option list.
137         * @param packagingData whether the resulting formatter should also append packaging
138         * data (jar/module and version) after each frame; see
139         * {@link ThrowableFormatter.Builder#packagingData(boolean)}.
140         * @return throwable formatter configured from the options.
141         */
142        public static ThrowableFormatter throwableFormatter(PatternKeyword node, boolean packagingData) {
143                return throwableFormatter(node, packagingData, false);
144        }
145
146        /**
147         * Like {@link #throwableFormatter(PatternKeyword, boolean)} but also able to build a
148         * root-cause-first formatter for <code>%rEx</code>/<code>%rootException</code>.
149         * @param node keyword node holding the option list.
150         * @param packagingData whether the resulting formatter should also append packaging
151         * data (jar/module and version) after each frame; see
152         * {@link ThrowableFormatter.Builder#packagingData(boolean)}.
153         * @param rootCauseFirst whether to print the root cause first; see
154         * {@link ThrowableFormatter.Builder#rootCauseFirst(boolean)}.
155         * @return throwable formatter configured from the options.
156         */
157        public static ThrowableFormatter throwableFormatter(PatternKeyword node, boolean packagingData,
158                        boolean rootCauseFirst) {
159                String depth = node.optOrNull(0);
160                int maxLines;
161                if (depth == null || depth.equalsIgnoreCase("full")) {
162                        maxLines = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
163                }
164                else if (depth.equalsIgnoreCase("short")) {
165                        maxLines = 0;
166                }
167                else {
168                        maxLines = Integer.parseInt(depth);
169                }
170                var options = node.optionList();
171                List<String> excludes = options.size() > 1 ? options.subList(1, options.size()) : List.of();
172                return ThrowableFormatter.builder()
173                        .maxLines(maxLines)
174                        .excludes(excludes)
175                        .packagingData(packagingData)
176                        .rootCauseFirst(rootCauseFirst)
177                        .build();
178        }
179
180}

182enum CallerInfoFormatter implements EventFormatter {
183
184        METHOD() {
185
186                @Override
187                protected void format(StringBuilder output, Caller info) {
188                        output.append(info.methodName());
189                }
190
191        },
192        CLASS {
193                @Override
194                protected void format(StringBuilder output, Caller info) {
195                        output.append(info.className());
196
197                }
198        },
199        FILE {
200                @Override
201                protected void format(StringBuilder output, Caller info) {
202                        output.append(info.fileNameOrNull());
203
204                }
205        },
206        LINE {
207                @Override
208                protected void format(StringBuilder output, Caller info) {
209                        output.append(info.lineNumber());
210
211                }
212        };
213
214        @Override
215        public void format(StringBuilder output, LogEvent event) {
216                var info = event.callerOrNull();
217                if (info != null) {
218                        format(output, info);
219                }
220
221        }
222
223        protected abstract void format(StringBuilder output, Caller caller);
224
225}

227enum StandardKeywordFactory implements KeywordFactory {
228
229        DATE() {
230                @Override
231                protected LogFormatter _create(PatternConfig config, PatternKeyword node) {
232                        String pattern = node.opt(0, ISO8601_PATTERN);
233                        if (pattern.equals(ISO8601_STR)) {
234                                pattern = ISO8601_PATTERN;
235                        }
236                        ZoneId zoneId = node.opt(1, config.zoneId(), s -> ZoneId.of(s));
237                        @Nullable Locale locale = node.optOrNull(2, s -> Locale.forLanguageTag(s));
238                        var dtf = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern(pattern).withZone(zoneId);
239                        if (locale != null) {
240                                dtf = dtf.withLocale(locale);
241                        }
242                        return LogFormatter.TimestampFormatter.of(dtf, isMillisOrCoarserPrecision(pattern));
243                }
244        },
245        /**
246         * <code>%r</code>, <code>%relative</code>: milliseconds elapsed since
247         * {@link PatternConfig#startTime()}.
248         */
249        RELATIVE() {
250
251                @Override
252                protected LogFormatter _create(PatternConfig config, PatternKeyword node) {
253                        return new RelativeTimeFormatter(config.startTime());
254                }
255
256        },
257        /**
258         * <code>%lsn</code>: a counter local to this compiled keyword occurrence, starting at
259         * {@link PatternConfig#sequenceNumberStart()} and incrementing once per event
260         * formatted.
261         */
262        LOCAL_SEQUENCE_NUMBER() {
263
264                @Override
265                protected LogFormatter _create(PatternConfig config, PatternKeyword node) {
266                        return new LocalSequenceNumberFormatter(new AtomicLong(config.sequenceNumberStart()));
267                }
268
269        },
270        LOGGER() {
271
272                @Override
273                protected LogFormatter _create(PatternConfig config, PatternKeyword node) {
274                        Integer length = node.optOrNull(0, Integer::parseInt);
275                        if (length == null) {
276                                return LogFormatter.builder().loggerName().build();
277                        }
278                        Abbreviator abbreviator = Abbreviator.of(length);
279                        if (config.abbreviatorCache() == PatternConfig.CacheType.BASIC) {
280                                abbreviator = Abbreviator.cache(abbreviator);
281                        }
282                        return new LoggerFormatter(abbreviator);
283                }
284
285        },
286        /**
287         * Logback/Log4j2 <code>%X</code>/<code>%mdc</code> style - see
288         * {@link LogFormatter.Builder#keyValues()} and
289         * {@link LogFormatter.Builder#keyValue(String, String)} for the exact format. For
290         * RainbowGum's own percent-encoded style instead, see {@link #ENCODED_MDC}.
291         */
292        MDC() {
293
294                @Override
295                protected LogFormatter _create(PatternConfig config, PatternKeyword node) {
296                        String key = node.optOrNull(0);
297                        if (key == null) {
298                                return LogFormatter.builder().keyValues().build();
299                        }
300                        var kf = keyAndFallback(key);
301                        return LogFormatter.builder().keyValue(kf.key(), kf.fallback()).build();
302                }
303
304        },
305        /**
306         * RainbowGum's percent-encoded (RFC 3986 URI query) MDC style - see
307         * {@link LogFormatter.Builder#encodedKeyValues()} and
308         * {@link LogFormatter.Builder#encodedKeyValue(String, String)} for the exact format.
309         * For Logback/Log4j2's <code>%X</code> style instead, see {@link #MDC}.
310         */
311        ENCODED_MDC() {
312
313                @Override
314                protected LogFormatter _create(PatternConfig config, PatternKeyword node) {
315                        String key = node.optOrNull(0);
316                        if (key == null) {
317                                return LogFormatter.builder().encodedKeyValues().build();
318                        }
319                        var kf = keyAndFallback(key);
320                        return LogFormatter.builder().encodedKeyValue(kf.key(), kf.fallback()).build();
321                }
322
323        },
324        PROPERTY() {
325
326                @Override
327                protected LogFormatter _create(PatternConfig config, PatternKeyword node) {
328                        String key = node.optOrNull(0);
329                        if (key == null) {
330                                return LogFormatter.builder().text("Property_HAS_NO_KEY").build();
331                        }
332                        var f = config.propertyFunction();
333                        var v = f.apply(key);
334                        if (v == null) {
335                                return LogFormatter.noop();
336                        }
337                        return LogFormatter.builder().text(v).build();
338                }
339
340        },
341        /**
342         * This comes from Spring Boot %esb
343         */
344        ENCLOSED_SQUARE_BRACKET() {
345
346                @Override
347                protected LogFormatter _create(PatternConfig config, PatternKeyword node) {
348                        String key = node.optOrNull(0);
349                        if (key == null) {
350                                return LogFormatter.noop();
351                        }
352                        var f = config.propertyFunction();
353                        var v = f.apply(key);
354                        if (v == null || v.isEmpty()) {
355                                return LogFormatter.noop();
356                        }
357                        return LogFormatter.builder().text("[").text(v).text("]").build();
358                }
359
360        },
361        /**
362         * <code>%ex</code>, <code>%ex{full}</code>, <code>%ex{short}</code>,
363         * <code>%ex{N}</code>, <code>%ex{N, regex1, regex2, ...}</code>.
364         */
365        THROWABLE() {
366
367                @Override
368                protected LogFormatter _create(PatternConfig config, PatternKeyword node) {
369                        return PatternFormatterFactory.throwableFormatter(node, false);
370                }
371
372                @Override
373                public boolean isExceptionFormatter() {
374                        return true;
375                }
376
377        },
378        /**
379         * <code>%xEx</code>, <code>%xEx{full}</code>, <code>%xEx{short}</code>,
380         * <code>%xEx{N}</code>, <code>%xEx{N, regex1, regex2, ...}</code>. Same options as
381         * {@link #THROWABLE} but also appends packaging data (jar/module and version) after
382         * each frame, similar to logback's <code>ExtendedThrowableProxyConverter</code>.
383         */
384        EXTENDED_THROWABLE() {
385
386                @Override
387                protected LogFormatter _create(PatternConfig config, PatternKeyword node) {
388                        return PatternFormatterFactory.throwableFormatter(node, true);
389                }
390
391                @Override
392                public boolean isExceptionFormatter() {
393                        return true;
394                }
395
396        },
397        /**
398         * <code>%rEx</code>, <code>%rEx{full}</code>, <code>%rEx{short}</code>,
399         * <code>%rEx{N}</code>, <code>%rEx{N, regex1, regex2, ...}</code>. Same options as
400         * {@link #EXTENDED_THROWABLE} (including packaging data) but the root cause prints
401         * first and each wrapper prints afterward, similar to logback's
402         * <code>RootCauseFirstThrowableProxyConverter</code>.
403         */
404        ROOT_EXCEPTION() {
405
406                @Override
407                protected LogFormatter _create(PatternConfig config, PatternKeyword node) {
408                        return PatternFormatterFactory.throwableFormatter(node, true, true);
409                }
410
411                @Override
412                public boolean isExceptionFormatter() {
413                        return true;
414                }
415
416        };
417
418        static final String ISO8601_STR = "ISO8601";
419
420        static final String ISO8601_PATTERN = "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss,SSS";
421
422        record KeyAndFallback(String key, @Nullable String fallback) {
423        }
424
425        /**
426         * Splits a <code>%X{key}</code>/<code>%mdc{key}</code> option on <code>:-</code>,
427         * Logback's syntax for a default value (e.g. <code>%X{requestId:-none}</code>).
428         */
429        static KeyAndFallback keyAndFallback(String option) {
430                String[] s = option.split(":-", 0);
431                if (s.length == 2) {
432                        return new KeyAndFallback(s[0], s[1]);
433                }
434                return new KeyAndFallback(option, null);
435        }
436
437        /**
438         * Whether a {@link DateTimeFormatter} pattern's finest resolution is milliseconds or
439         * coarser, i.e. it never renders sub-millisecond digits. Used to decide whether the
440         * formatted string can be safely cached and reused for events landing in the same
441         * millisecond (see
442         * {@link LogFormatter.TimestampFormatter#of(DateTimeFormatter, boolean)}).
443         */
444        static boolean isMillisOrCoarserPrecision(String pattern) {
445                boolean literal = false;
446                int consecutiveS = 0;
447                for (int i = 0; i < pattern.length(); i++) {
448                        char c = pattern.charAt(i);
449                        if (c == '\'') {
450                                literal = !literal;
451                                consecutiveS = 0;
452                                continue;
453                        }
454                        if (literal) {
455                                continue;
456                        }
457                        if (c == 'n' || c == 'N') {
458                                return false;
459                        }
460                        if (c == 'S') {
461                                consecutiveS++;
462                                if (consecutiveS > 3) {
463                                        return false;
464                                }
465                        }
466                        else {
467                                consecutiveS = 0;
468                        }
469                }
470                return true;
471        }
472
473        // MICROS, //
474        // THREAD, //
475        // LEVEL, //
476        // LOGGER, //
477        // MESSAGE, //
478        // MDC, //
479        // THROWABLE, //
480        // LINESEP;
481
482        @Override
483        public LogFormatter create(PatternConfig config, PatternKeyword node) {
484                var formatter = _create(config, node);
485                var formatInfo = node.padding();
486                return PadFormatter.of(formatter, formatInfo);
487        }
488
489        protected abstract LogFormatter _create(PatternConfig config, PatternKeyword node);
490
491        record LoggerFormatter(Abbreviator abbreviator) implements LogFormatter.EventFormatter {
492
493                @Override
494                public void format(StringBuilder output, LogEvent event) {
495                        String out = abbreviator.abbreviate(event.loggerName());
496                        output.append(out);
497
498                }
499
500        }
501
502        record RelativeTimeFormatter(Instant startTime) implements LogFormatter.EventFormatter {
503
504                @Override
505                public void format(StringBuilder output, LogEvent event) {
506                        long millis = Duration.between(startTime, event.timestamp()).toMillis();
507                        output.append(millis);
508                }
509
510        }
511
512        record LocalSequenceNumberFormatter(AtomicLong counter) implements LogFormatter.EventFormatter {
513
514                @Override
515                public void format(StringBuilder output, LogEvent event) {
516                        output.append(counter.getAndIncrement());
517                }
518
519        }
520
521}

540
541        final static String ESC_END = "m";
542
543        final static String BOLD = "1;";
544
545        final static String FAINT = "2;";
546
547        final static String RESET = "0;";
548
549        final static String BLACK_FG = "30";
550
551        final static String RED_FG = "31";
552
553        final static String GREEN_FG = "32";
554
555        final static String YELLOW_FG = "33";
556
557        final static String BLUE_FG = "34";
558
559        final static String MAGENTA_FG = "35";
560
561        final static String CYAN_FG = "36";
562
563        final static String WHITE_FG = "37";
564
565        final static String DEFAULT_FG = "39";
566
567        final static String GRAY_FG = BOLD + BLACK_FG; // Logback is a little weird about gray
568
569        final static String SET_DEFAULT_COLOR = ESC_START + RESET + DEFAULT_FG + ESC_END;
570
571        /*
572         * Spring Boot colors
573         */
574        final static String BRIGHT_BLACK = "90";
575
576        final static String BRIGHT_RED = "91";

578        final static String BRIGHT_GREEN = "92";
579

583

587

592record HighlightFormatter(@Nullable LogFormatter child) implements LogFormatter.EventFormatter {
593
594        @Override
595        public void format(StringBuilder output, LogEvent event) {
596                /*
597                 * TODO should a null child be a noop? Need to see what logback does for compat.
598                 */
599                var level = event.level();
600                String code = levelToANSI(level);
601                output.append(ANSIConstants.ESC_START);
602                output.append(code);
603                output.append(ANSIConstants.ESC_END);
604                if (child != null) {
605                        child.format(output, event);
606                }
607                output.append(ANSIConstants.SET_DEFAULT_COLOR);
608        }
609
610        private static String levelToANSI(Level level) {
611                return switch (level) {
612                        case ERROR -> BOLD + RED_FG;
613                        case WARNING -> BOLD + RED_FG;
614                        case INFO -> BLUE_FG;
615                        default -> DEFAULT_FG;
616                };
617        }
618
619}
620
621/*
622 * From Spring Boot
623 */
624record ClrLevelFormatter(@Nullable LogFormatter child) implements LogFormatter.EventFormatter {
625
626        @Override
627        public void format(StringBuilder output, LogEvent event) {
628                /*
629                 * TODO should a null child be a noop? Need to see what logback does for compat.
630                 */
631                var level = event.level();
632                String code = levelToANSI(level);
633                output.append(ANSIConstants.ESC_START);
634                output.append(code);
635                output.append(ANSIConstants.ESC_END);
636                if (child != null) {
637                        child.format(output, event);
638                }
639                output.append(ANSIConstants.SET_DEFAULT_COLOR);
640        }
641
642        private static String levelToANSI(Level level) {
643                return switch (level) {
644                        case ERROR -> RED_FG;
645                        case WARNING -> YELLOW_FG;
646                        case INFO -> GREEN_FG;
647                        case DEBUG -> GREEN_FG;
648                        case TRACE -> GREEN_FG;
649                        default -> DEFAULT_FG;
650                };
651        }
652
653}
654
655record ClrStaticFormatter(@Nullable LogFormatter child, String code) implements LogFormatter.EventFormatter {
656
657        @Override
658        public void format(StringBuilder output, LogEvent event) {
659                output.append(ANSIConstants.ESC_START);
660                output.append(code);
661                output.append(ANSIConstants.ESC_END);
662                if (child != null) {
663                        child.format(output, event);
664                }
665                output.append(ANSIConstants.SET_DEFAULT_COLOR);
666        }
667
668}

670enum HighlightCompositeFactory implements CompositeFactory {
671
672        HIGHTLIGHT() {
673
674                @Override
675                public LogFormatter create(PatternConfig config, PatternKeyword node, @Nullable LogFormatter child) {
676                        if (config.ansiDisabled()) {
677                                if (child == null) {
678                                        return LogFormatter.noop();
679                                }
680                                return child;
681                        }
682                        return new HighlightFormatter(child);
683                }
684
685        },
686
687        /**
688         * This style come from Spring Boot.
689         */
690        CLR() {
691
692                @Override
693                public LogFormatter create(PatternConfig config, PatternKeyword node, @Nullable LogFormatter child) {
694                        if (config.ansiDisabled()) {
695                                if (child == null) {
696                                        return LogFormatter.noop();
697                                }
698                                return child;
699                        }
700                        String color = node.optOrNull(0, HighlightCompositeFactory::clrParseColor);
701                        if (color == null) {
702                                return new ClrLevelFormatter(child);
703                        }
704                        return new ClrStaticFormatter(child, color);
705                }
706
707        };
708
709        static String clrParseColor(String color) {
710                color = color.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
711                return switch (color) {
712                        case "black" -> BLACK_FG;
713                        case "white" -> WHITE_FG;
714                        case "blue" -> BLUE_FG;
715                        case "cyan" -> CYAN_FG;
716                        case "faint" -> FAINT + DEFAULT_FG;
717                        case "green" -> GREEN_FG;
718                        case "magenta" -> MAGENTA_FG;
719                        case "red" -> RED_FG;
720                        case "yellow" -> YELLOW_FG;
721                        case "bright_black" -> BRIGHT_BLACK;
722                        case "bright_red" -> BRIGHT_RED;
723                        case "bright_green" -> BRIGHT_GREEN;
724                        case "bright_yellow" -> BRIGHT_YELLOW;
725                        case "bright_blue" -> BRIGHT_BLUE;
726                        case "bright_magenta" -> BRIGHT_MAGENTA;
727                        case "bright_cyan" -> BRIGHT_CYAN;
728                        case "bright_white" -> BRIGHT_WHITE;
729                        default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Bad color:" + color);
730                };
731        }
732
733}
734
735/**
736 * This style of colors largely comes from logback
737 */
738enum ColorCompositeFactory implements CompositeFactory {
739
740        BLACK(BLACK_FG, "black"), //
741        RED(RED_FG, "red"), //
742        GREEN(GREEN_FG, "green"), //
743        YELLOW(YELLOW_FG, "yellow"), //
744        BLUE(BLUE_FG, "blue"), //
745        MAGENTA(MAGENTA_FG, "magenta"), //
746        CYAN(CYAN_FG, "cyan"), //
747        WHITE(WHITE_FG, "white"), //
748        GRAY(GRAY_FG, "gray"), //
749        BOLD_RED(BOLD + RED_FG, "boldRed"), //
750        BOLD_GREEN(BOLD + GREEN_FG, "boldGreen"), //
751        BOLD_YELLOW(BOLD + YELLOW_FG, "boldYellow"), //
752        BOLD_BLUE(BOLD + BLUE_FG, "boldBlue"), //
753        BOLD_MAGENTA(BOLD + MAGENTA_FG, "boldMagenta"), //
754        BOLD_CYAN(BOLD + CYAN_FG, "boldCyan"), //
755        BOLD_WHITE(BOLD + WHITE_FG, "boldWhite");
756
757        private final String fg;
758
759        private final String name;
760
761        private ColorCompositeFactory(String fg, String name) {
762                this.fg = fg;
763                this.name = name;
764        }
765
766        @Override
767        public LogFormatter create(PatternConfig config, PatternKeyword node, @Nullable LogFormatter child) {
768                return create(node, child, !config.ansiDisabled());
769        }
770
771        LogFormatter create(PatternKeyword node, @Nullable LogFormatter child, boolean ansi) {
772                var b = LogFormatter.builder();
773                if (ansi) {
774                        b.text(ANSIConstants.ESC_START);
775                        b.text(fg);
776                        b.text(ANSIConstants.ESC_END);
777                }
778                if (child != null) {
779                        b.add(child);
780                }
781                if (ansi) {
782                        b.text(ANSIConstants.SET_DEFAULT_COLOR);
783                }
784                return b.build();
785
786        }
787
788        public String alias() {
789                return name;
790        }
791
792}
793
794record PadFormatter(Padding padding, LogFormatter formatter) implements LogFormatter.EventFormatter {
795
796        public static LogFormatter of(LogFormatter formatter, @Nullable Padding padding) {
797                if (padding == null) {
798                        return formatter;
799                }
800                if (formatter instanceof LogFormatter.StaticFormatter sf) {
801                        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
802                        padding.format(b, sf.content());
803                        return new LogFormatter.StaticFormatter(b.toString());
804                }
805                return new PadFormatter(padding, formatter);
806        }
807
808        @Override
809        public void format(StringBuilder output, LogEvent event) {
810                /*
811                 * TODO revisit formatting without using a temp buffer
812                 */
813                StringBuilder buf = new StringBuilder();
814                formatter.format(buf, event);
815                padding.format(output, buf);
816        }
817
818}
